subject: general
question:
The following bar graph shows the number of pages read by five friends when they went to a library.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a44835ff789d54778414aec2c39d8cc45e4fa4a293d7aa14c16ba1d6eb27c4c4.png] 

In percentage terms, how many more pages did Rishi read than Neha?
solution:
**Given:-**

(1) The number of pages read by Rishi = 60

(2) The number of pages read by Neha =50

**Formula used:-**

Percentage more = [(higher value - lower value)/lowervalue] × 100 

**Calculation:-**

As per the question,

The Percentage of more Rishi read than Neha = [(60 - 50)/50] × 100 

 

 ⇒ (10/50) × 100 

⇒ 20% 

**∴ The required answer is 20%.**
